tokens.name: bg-deep
tokens.usage: Window title bar and the bottom status strip. Darkest surface.

tokens.name: bg-nav
tokens.usage: Top navigation bar, icon rail and bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: App background behind everything; the library list well and page body.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Cards, capsules, dialogs, detail panels. Sits on bg-base.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, hovered rows, selected row fill, art placeholders. Sits on bg-panel or bg-base.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, switches and unselected chips. 3:1 on bg-base and bg-panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-base, bg-panel, bg-raised, bg-nav and bg-deep.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive nav labels on bg-base, bg-panel, bg-raised, bg-nav. Also allowed over art on deck-scrim.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, metadata (size, date, version) on bg-base, bg-panel, bg-nav, deck-bg. Not for disabled text, and never over art: on deck-scrim over a white image it reaches only 3.8:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, selected state, focus ring, progress fill for downloads, primary-button fill. Readable as text on every surface.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent controls and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-hover fill.

tokens.name: install
tokens.usage: Fill of the Install / Play / Update call to action, one per screen region. Steam-style green.

tokens.name: install-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the install button.

tokens.name: on-install
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an install or install-hover fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Installed / verified status text and icon on bg-panel, bg-base and ok-bg.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind an ok status badge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Update available / needs your file status text on bg-panel, bg-base and warn-bg.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a warn status badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed / error text and icon on bg-panel, bg-base and danger-bg.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a danger badge and error banners.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status text (queued, installing) on bg-panel, bg-base and info-bg.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind an info badge.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: deck-bg
tokens.usage: Deck mode page background and the base under the Big Art backdrop. Deck mode is dark only, so both themes carry the same value.

tokens.name: deck-scrim
tokens.usage: 82% deck-bg laid over Big Art wherever text sits on art (hero title, tile caption). Text over it must still hold 4.5:1 against a pure white image.

tokens.name: focus-glow
tokens.usage: Outer glow of the focused element in Deck mode: accent at 45%. Decoration only; the 3px accent border carries the focus meaning.

styles.name: title-hero
styles.usage: Game name on the hero banner (wide).

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: Page title; hero name on phone.

styles.name: body-touch
styles.usage: Body text at touch / controller density.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and top-nav items (set the string uppercase in code).

styles.name: deck-title
styles.usage: Deck mode: game name on the hero.

styles.name: deck-heading
styles.usage: Deck mode: shelf titles, panel titles, section tabs.

styles.name: deck-body
styles.usage: Deck mode: body text and list rows.

styles.name: deck-meta
styles.usage: Deck mode: metadata. Not over art (use deck-label in ink).

styles.name: deck-hint
styles.usage: Deck mode: button hint labels along the bottom bar.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Versions, tags like v1.4.2, hashes, install paths, release asset names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on handheld; gap between capsules.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default panel padding and page gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero inner padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large section separation; touch row height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, progress bars, chips. Steam-like near-square corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, capsules, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, bottom sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch track and knob only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Capsule on hover; card resting on bg-base.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / gamepad focus ring. Solid accent, 3:1 on all surfaces. Freya: a 2px accent border, there is no spread shadow.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Library list column at wide breakpoint.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Icon rail at compact breakpoint.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top nav height on pointer devices.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height on phone.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Library row height, pointer density.

tokens.name: row-h-touch
tokens.usage: Library row height, touch / controller density.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target on touch density.

tokens.name: capsule-w
tokens.usage: Game capsule width (3:4 portrait art).

tokens.name: capsule-h
tokens.usage: Game capsule art height.

tokens.name: hero-h
tokens.usage: Game page banner height at wide.

tokens.name: deck-safe-x
tokens.usage: Deck mode: horizontal safe-zone margin from the screen edge, for TV overscan. User-adjustable up to 96px.

tokens.name: deck-safe-y
tokens.usage: Deck mode: vertical safe-zone margin from the screen edge.

tokens.name: deck-tile-w
tokens.usage: Deck mode: game tile width (3:4 portrait art).

tokens.name: deck-tile-h
tokens.usage: Deck mode: game tile height.

tokens.name: deck-tile-gap
tokens.usage: Deck mode: gap between tiles in a shelf; also the room the focus scale grows into.

tokens.name: deck-row-h
tokens.usage: Deck mode: list row height (menus, quick access). Twice the pointer row.

tokens.name: deck-target-min
tokens.usage: Deck mode: minimum hit and focus target.

tokens.name: deck-hint-h
tokens.usage: Deck mode: height of the button-hint bar along the bottom safe zone.

tokens.name: deck-tabs-h
tokens.usage: Deck mode: height of the section tab strip.

tokens.name: deck-panel-w
tokens.usage: Deck mode: width of the left and right slide-in panels.

tokens.name: deck-focus-scale
tokens.usage: Deck mode: how much the focused element grows. Needs deck-tile-gap of room.

tokens.name: deck-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Deck mode: focus border width, solid accent.

tokens.name: deck-menu-w
tokens.usage: Deck mode: width of one column of a centered option menu; a submenu opens as a second column.

tokens.name: deck-settings-nav-w
tokens.usage: Deck mode: width of the section list beside the rows of a two-pane settings page.

tokens.name: deck-settings-row-h
tokens.usage: Deck mode: height of a settings row. Rows are one line, so descriptions are short. A text row adds 72px.

tokens.name: deck-two-pane-min-w
tokens.usage: Deck mode: windows at least this wide show settings as two panes; narrower ones drill from a list into a section.

tokens.name: surface-header-h
tokens.usage: Full-screen pages: header with Back and the title.

tokens.name: surface-header-h-compact
tokens.usage: Full-screen pages: header while a keyboard covers over 40% of the window.

tokens.name: surface-footer-h
tokens.usage: Full-screen pages: footer holding the actions.

tokens.name: surface-max-w
tokens.usage: Full-screen pages: widest the reading column grows; two-pane pages use the full width.

tokens.name: surface-short-h
tokens.usage: Full-screen pages: under this window height the footer actions move into the header.

tokens.name: surface-touch-popup-min-h
tokens.usage: A touch screen at least this tall keeps popup forms; shorter ones get full-screen pages.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Min width for full sidebar layout.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: Min width for icon rail layout; below it is handheld / phone.
